chunks: Yet they have made the angels, who are creatures of Ar-Rahman, females. Did they witness their creation? We shall record their testimony, and they will be interrogated.
ai.seo_question: Why did the Arabs consider angels to be female and what is the Quranic refutation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Ibn al-Salih' (son of the servant) to highlight the absurdity of attributing gender to purely spiritual beings, reinforcing the transcendence of Allah. The rhetorical challenge emphasizes that their claim was based on conjecture rather than witnessed creation, serving as a precursor to the detailed critique of their idolatrous practices in the subsequent verses. This attribution is viewed as a specific manifestation of their broader theological error in projecting human characteristics onto the divine realm.
